resources.string: Standalone Metroid Prime VR for Quest 3. Select your original USA GameCube ROM (GM8E01, revision 0), then launch in VR.

string-array.name: quest_graphics_preset_options
string-array.item: 1× Performance (fallback)\n1× resolution, 72 Hz. Leaves more rendering headroom.
2× Performance\n2× resolution, 120 Hz. Optional reduced shading detail on eligible scenery; keeps HUD and menus at full quality.
2× Full Quality\n2× resolution, 120 Hz. Full shading detail throughout the scene.
